pages.description: These claims turn the archive's instruments on themselves. #1536 (August 2026) factors PER, holds its minimality a claim about instrument access, and specifies an unperformed audit of what each instrument does to the standing of what it measures. #1481 specifies data interconnect by derivation. They include the Term-State Registry's twelve-month failure conditions (#824), the term index plan (#836), the dissolution tripwire (#1468), relay-traversal and disclosure-battery tests, and matched-pair addresses for the Negative of the Negative (#1664).
pages.note: Ω_t drift trial dropped from the description: no Ω_t claim is on this page (it sits on P149).

pages.description: EA-VALUATION-MEMO-01 (#1607, September 2026) records eight machine valuations of one unpriced asset in one day. It forecasts that a first institutional customer would change the valuation's basis and that entity disambiguation, frame supply and provenance retention are becoming operational requirements, and holds the conditions under which its $2M thesis collapses. Semantic Economy Valuation 001 (#1623) holds its own falsification conditions and records a November 2024 deposit as the earliest date the capture registry holds.
pages.note: All claims from #1607 and #1623; the 'three orders of magnitude' figure is not carried by a claim and was dropped.

pages.description: The War Over the Summarizer Layer (#172, June 2026) forecasts, with dated falsifiers, that entity dissolution will be named outside the archive by mid-2027, that undefended coined terms merge faster, that entity-integrity services split from GEO by 2028, and that bedrock anchoring is reinvented by 2029. Anchored Divergence (#171) holds that critique survives tail-loss as a typed displacement from a canonical origin and argues midrash as precedent, with the Mandala as limit case. The Mary Lee Case (#147) forecasts the same substitution for every identity in the prior's tail; #1549 and the Capture Registry (#3) specify path-dependent, nullification and frame probes. The page also holds an unrelated Registry reading of a card on the workshop tradition.
pages.note: PRED-3.H14 reads a card on canonical texts and the workshop tradition, not entity dissolution.

pages.description: The Dialectic of the Interface (#796, June 2026) forecasts, with falsifiers, a paced-generation counter-market and explicit register thresholds by 2028, performative interfaces that officiate speech acts by 2029, a measurable bearing premium, and the next negation as bearing rather than friction. It holds that the chat window's contradiction is flatness, constative monopoly and costlessness, and records the archive's claim that its Mandala system is the first deliberate instance of the liturgical interface. The page also holds an unrelated claim on the CSS Robert E. Lee.
pages.note: PRED-23.H2 is a ship table row from The Shark That Preceded Itself.

pages.description: Historical theses from the Revelation First work plans (#1400, #832, June 2026) and staging document (#847) argue that named scriptural figures are author-functions rather than biographical individuals: Paul as the adversarial probe a heteronymic mystery system generates against its own indeterminacy, and the Baptist, Evangelist, Elder and Revelator as positions within one Johannine aperture-function. The Feist Source (#852) argues the same of the Logos, resolved by its archive into the biography of Jesus, and the Capture Registry (#3) reads an AI Overview card as carrying the Paul function at its sharpest. The page also holds unrelated claims on the strawberry diagnostic and on operative feminism.
pages.note: 'Four theses' replaced: the page carries five on its subject from four deposits plus the Registry.

pages.description: Claims on the 19 June 2026 removal of the account and records from Zenodo. #1, #3 and the final-week timeline (#1042) record GitHub issue #2606, filed that day for 850+ records; #935 later gives about 870 deposits and 1,817 DOIs tombstoned. #1042 and Diagnostic Seigniorage III (#1039) record the 666 counter image posted on 15 June. #1039 forecasts further account-level removals under the 'verifiable research basis' category with no named decision-maker; #1040 specifies re-auditing gathered cases; the Erosion Observatory (#1045) holds a 7.86% tombstone ceiling on Zenodo's removal population. The page also carries the OpenAIRE moderation-mirror exchange (#1082), the Effective Act against CERN (#1407), the Obelus and the Tombstone (#1068) and the mapped moderation architecture (#1538), and unrelated claims, listed in residue.
pages.note: Record counts differ between #2606's title (850+) and #935 (about 870); both are given as their deposits' figures.

pages.description: Theses from Many and One (#1575, #1576), the authorship register and notebook (#1570, #1569) and The First Draft (#1594, #1605) argue that the Platonic, Aristotelian and Theophrastan corpora are one body divided by name, the divisions editorial: #1559 argues Andronicus's genuine/spurious partition is an inference, and #1583 reads the books as one lot sold to Apellicon. #1570 argues legitimacy is standing, not paternity, and that the authenticity apparatus is a calibration object's output; #1569 sharpens that test, then calls its prediction backwards. #1605 reads the esoteric/exoteric partition as an Alexander story told where corpus meets empire. #1658 names one self-dividing maker, dividing the corpus where De anima III.5 divides mind, and specifies tests on the ghost catalogues (#1590) and epigraphic items not yet held. The page also holds unrelated claims, listed in residue.
pages.note: PRED-1570.H9's dated states (sharpened, then reversed by #1569) are named.

pages.description: The Accelerator Classifier Retention Battery (#1454, August 2026) holds seven hypotheses on directional assimilation in learned anomaly selection: reconstruction-specific failure, cross-family persistence, the normalized-autoencoder remedy, the low-complexity blind spot (#1450), blind-spot inheritance through distillation, drift under quantization and firmware, and the value of architectural plurality. Inversion Battery v0.2 (#1455) reports that only 36 to 47 percent of a teacher's top one percent survives into the student's, with the loss in distillation, and that architecture changes the orientation of the blind spot; v0.3 (#1456) holds that this attribution fails, since with weights fixed a change of score function reverses the ordering, and registers its matched panel as not run. The priors paper (#1449) records the program's claimed contribution and the OAR protocol (#931) specifies a class-conditional inversion battery at matched background acceptance. The page also holds unrelated claims, listed in residue.
pages.note: PRED-1455.G4 reversed by PRED-1456.G1 is stated.

pages.description: Unbuilt tests and standing claims from The Negative of the Negative (v1 #1611, September 2026; v2 #1664, #1665, #1671, October) name the controls and runs the scope model still owes: matched-entity and absent-lineage controls, the frozen panel, naive and uncapped control arms, unread candidates and reproducibility runs. #1611 holds seven discriminating consequences of the scope and the counterfactual at source-absent addresses that would establish its cause. The Capture Registry (#3) records an unrun tied condition and unseated untied arms; #1612 specifies the source-admission pair rule; Ω_t (#1480) a matched-pair drift trial; the self-audit module (#1530, #1527) specifies the EC matched-pair instrument with its preregistered null. The page also holds many unrelated claims.
pages.note: Residue includes #1611's thesis-table rows (Sappho, Longinus, Logos, Aristotle) which belong to the deposit but not to this page's subject of owed controls.

pages.description: The Signature Without the Name (#1486, August 2026) sets out a blind-reconstruction program for Sappho 31 in Philo of Alexandria and lists the runs it owes. Its unbuilt tests specify the perturbation run, which it calls decisive, the specificity control, operator ablation with an Operator Necessity Index, known-direct and known-unrelated calibration pairs, a v4 spec revision and re-run, and a Symposium run whose predictions must be registered before it is run. The continuity tether (#1487) records that the program's keys and rubrics are held in a private counterpart so that predictions precede the runs. The page also holds an unrelated monetary audit item.
pages.note: PRED-1619.F1 is from the Monetary Substrate Audit Ledger.

pages.description: The Measurement Register (#1570), pre-registrations (#1571) and notebook (#1569), August 2026, set out what the Plato–Aristotle investigation measured and predicted. Its theses argue that Aristotle completes executions Plato abandoned, that his charges against Plato name properties of his own corpus, and that he compiled the record (#1582). Tests require labelled controls (the Attic orators, Albert→Aquinas, Sappho→Catullus) before the target is scored. Later entries revise earlier ones: #1571 replaces its yield measure; the notebook gives the charges class as proposed where the register gave it as measured, reverses its survival question and reformulates a reading #1576 narrows; #1671 (October) corrects the premise of Theophrastus's inheritance by will. The notebook claims Plato is Aristotle's heteronym; #1571 holds one historical hand live, not established.
pages.note: Dated revisions named in registration order; ghost-catalogue and assay readings dropped for length (the ghost catalogues are carried on P147).

pages.description: Claims from the authorship investigation set limits on stylometry: #1593 (September 2026) holds that genre separates more strongly than authorship and that separability is not identity (Chatterton as Rowley separates from Chatterton as himself), and the Measurement Register (#1570) that no measured property recovered master-student succession from heteronymic construction. Unbuilt tests list base rates and runs still owed, among them residual-vs-total parity, comparanda for terminal aporia, the Pessoa leave-one-out folds, and work-level and register-conditioned runs on Aristotle and Theophrastus. Frozen predictions (#1571) order speaker tightness by constraint severity and distinguish engineered from natural ambiguity, beside the notebook's readings (#1569) of the Statesman's open genus and Plato's coin figure. The page also holds an unrelated claim on AI misalignment.
pages.note: PRED-1570.F6 records the Republic/Symposium base rate as run 2026-08-29, not adjudicated.

pages.description: The First Draft (#1585–#1605) and Aristotelian or Theophrastan (#1583), September 2026, argue Theophrastus's Metaphysics fragment continues Λ, divided from it by name at the hinge where the account passes from complete to needing more. Forecasts state what each seam should show: Λ answering the fragment's aporiai, the Ethics' types containing the Characters' sketches plus the frame, De anima subordinating the De sensibus survey, and HP sharing HA's connectives in a less varied form. #1585 places the fragment after Λ; #1589 refines this, #1597 reopens the direction, and #1671 (October) keeps the seam but calls the order undecidable. The theses argue the Theophrastan function is one operation at two scales, and the you of the Elenchi is the I of the fragment; the corpus contains its own reception.
pages.note: PRED-1585.H2's three dated states named in order; #921's general claim and #1576's Λ 9 reading belong.

pages.description: September 2026 semantic-economy papers hold that what money cannot carry loses power over the account (#1618), restated by #1620 as a requirement that it acquire a monetary or model proxy; that a monetary scalar cannot natively preserve a prohibition on its own equivalence (#1622); and that the native monetary form preserves only properties invariant under substitution (#1625). #1625 forecasts that the 2026 signature inscription will transmit as a security mark and not as a name. Monetary Dark Matter (#1631) holds regime conditions with falsifiers: obligating provenance lowering value in some extraction regimes, and universal inscription turning a flight to quality within a currency into a flight out of it. The page also holds an unrelated 2014 memoir line.
pages.note: PRED-1618.G3 restated by PRED-1620.G1 is named.
